method: Full static graph using native CPU cell updates and local phase/connectivity/fatigue assumptions. Synthetic foot evidence becomes airborne on neural knee flexion and lands after 18 fixture steps (45 for late_landing) with extension. No neural state or motor command is injected. This is not a physical robot simulation.
limitations: No Webots physics or Prima-Lux device run.
No claim that harness steps equal simulation milliseconds.
Bumpers measure contact, not load; useful weight transfer is unverified.
Missing landing holds next preparation/push but does not capture the next swing turn until evidence arrives or STOP clears it.
